title: Toggle Case
statement:
Given a string S, toggle the case of every letter: uppercase letters become lowercase and lowercase letters become uppercase.

Non-letter characters remain unchanged.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single line: S with every letter's case toggled.

examples.explanation: Each uppercase letter is lowercased and each lowercase letter is uppercased.
